adapter.purpose: Scans TypeScript and JavaScript files for imports and exports and resolves each specifier like tsc

packages.node:fs: Reads source files, tsconfig files and package.json files of the project
packages.node:module: Loads the TypeScript of the project with createRequire and tells built-ins apart
packages.node:path: Resolves specifiers against folders and turns paths into POSIX project paths
packages.typescript: Types of the compiler API that reads tsconfig.json and resolves package imports

adapter.external: Entry of @slopbuckets/adapter-ts, which the CLI bundles and calls in-process
